notes.title: The major v2.0 update is now available!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38280149/d0f9b566fa1b9523cb89c90666133143858fd8a3.png"]



List of changes in version v2.0.0:



Graphical changes:

Completely updated game graphics

Redesigned character animations

Updated characters and their styles

Some secondary characters have been changed

Level decorations updated

Animations added to some objects

Lighting on levels fixed and improved

Main menu appearance updated

Textures in the main menu updated

Interface and buttons updated

Game intro updated

Graphical bugs fixed



Gameplay changes:

Changed camera angle and distance from the character

Easter egg mini-game updated

Campaign completion screen updated

New easter eggs added

Some bugs fixed



Steam store changes:

All game icons, images, and logos updated

Icons and names of some achievements updated

Game trailer and screenshots updated



It’s been a long journey, but I made it and drew this wonderful update for you!
Thank you for still supporting the game :)

notes.title: Global graphics update - in development!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38280149/fb2450d7c40d3aa8091f162a099efd07ad95e938.jpg

Today, I'm excited to announce that I’ve recently started working on a major update for Painted Legend 2! I plan to overhaul and enhance all graphics and animations in the game, just like I did a year ago with the first part!

Perhaps the most noticeable change, which you might have already seen in the screenshot, is the new art style. The game will now fully adopt the style of the first part and the sequel, Knights of Ink & Paper. I’ve been thinking about this idea for a long time and finally decided to bring it to life! But if you prefer the original style, which is more reminiscent of 80s cartoons, don’t worry—the game will still include an option to play with the previous graphics and animations!

Additionally, the update will introduce more decorative elements and a revamped interface with a redesigned main menu. The update will be completely free for all current and future owners of the game!

Thank you for your attention :)
